layer1.name: Bannerbear
layer1.one_liner: An API that generates social images and banners automatically.
layer1.description: Developers post data to an API and get back rendered images from a template — social cards, certificates, ecommerce banners. Solo founder, developer-tool pricing, after a string of earlier failed products.
layer1.outcome_note: Bootstrapped past $10k MRR in roughly two years and reported around $630k ARR by early 2025. The founder published the revenue journey publicly throughout.

sources.note: Founder's own write-up of bootstrapping to $10k MRR
